payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning': the couple has Costa Rica on the shortlist and needs the legal sequence before they commit to a resort or coast, so the invitation to Wedded Concierge appears only once the Registro Civil and notary steps, certificate and recognition are covered and the post turns to regions, venues and planning. The Wedded Advisor is positioned for planning only, never for legal paperwork, notary arrangements, registration, apostilles or translations. Each subtext carries one brand-facts reassurance: inclusions in writing (primary), single point of contact (secondary), AUD quotes, time zone and fee in writing (closing). No figures, 'free', perks, Privileges, availability or call-first wording. All four tracked links already appear once each with correct UTMs, so no copy change is made. A printable Costa Rica legal-steps checklist would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed.
